caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped, light blue box with a fitted lid. The surface of the box is decorated with illustrations of buildings, trees, fences, pathways, gardens, and people. The central building on the front of the box appears rectangular with multiple windows and chimneys, and is flanked by a smaller, towered structure on the right. There are green, cone-shaped trees interspersed between the buildings and along the paths. The details are rendered in shades of brown, tan, green, and blue. The box also features text, most notably “WESLEYAN UNIVERSITY AT MIDDLETOWN CONN” across the front panel, and smaller text identifying other elements such as “PALESTINE GARDEN.” The lid of the box includes similar illustrations of buildings and trees, with text and decorative patterns along the rim. A small signature, “P. Ward,” appears at the bottom right. The overall style resembles folk or historical illustration, and the composition is balanced to fit the curved surfaces of the box.
title: Bandbox
